cases.setup: The repository has one modified tracked file and one untracked test file.
assertions: Inspects both the tracked diff and the untracked file content
Returns one to three outcome-focused bullets
Does not claim that any change was pushed

cases.prompt: Push this and explain what was pushed in three bullets.
cases.setup: HEAD is one commit ahead of its configured upstream and the working tree is clean.
assertions: Collects outgoing evidence immediately before the push
Summarizes only the outgoing commit range
Reports the destination branch after a successful push
Does not include uncommitted work in the pushed summary

cases.setup: The working tree is clean and HEAD has no commits ahead of upstream.
assertions: States that there are no current changes
Does not summarize the latest commit unless recent history was requested

cases.setup: The current branch has commits but no configured upstream or explicit push target.
assertions: States that the outgoing range cannot be established
Does not present local commits as definitely pushed
Uses an explicit push target if the surrounding request provides one
